Eine faszinierende Reise führt nach Costa Rica, das Bindeglied zwischen Nord- und Südamerika. Auf einer schmalen Landzunge gelegen, trennt es den Pazifischen Ozean von der Karibischen See und steht auf der Liste der Biodiversität ganz weit oben.

Die Schweizer Bergbahnen führen durch majestätische Landschafte. Diese Folge führt mit der Zahnradbahn auf den Monte Generoso. Vom Gipfel auf 1601 Metern hat man einen spektakulären Rundumblick auf die höchsten Berge der Schweizer Alpen.

Das Bellevue des Alpen und die Schatzalp sind zwei legendäre Berghotels. Die dritte Folge erzählt von ihren Besitzern, ihren Gästen und der magischen Anziehungskraft der Alpen. Berghotels als Stützpunkt und Zuflucht: Während Abenteurer und Alpinisten im Bellevue letzte Kraft sammelten, um die berühmt-berüchtigte Eiger-Nordwand zu bezwingen, fuhr das feine Bürgertum nach Davos, um im Luxussanatorium Heilung an Körper und Seele zu finden.

Die letzte Folge der Reihe stellt zwei weltberühmte Stadthotels vor: The Dolder Grand in Zürich und Les Trois Rois in Basel. Sie sind Treffpunkte der High Society - damals wie heute. Städte pulsieren, wachsen, verändern sich - und mit ihnen die Hotels. In den traditionsreichen Häusern lässt sich erleben, wie sehr sich die modernen Lebens- und Reisegewohnheiten verändert haben.

In Teil eins geht es um das Montreux Palace und das Monte Rosa: zwei Hotels, die von den Anfängen der Schweizer Tourismusgeschichte erzählen. Hinter ihren ehrwürdigen Gemäuern verbergen sich auch die Hinterlassenschaften von britischen Reisenden, die die Hotels und ihre Umgebung zu dem machten, was sie heute sind: touristische Sehnsuchtsorte. Die ersten Gäste im Hotel Monte Rosa, der ältesten Herberge des hochalpinen Ferienorts Zermatt, waren Forscher, Literaten und Künstler.

Der arbeitslose Komponist Clément Mathieu erhält 1949 eine Anstellung als Aufseher in einem französischen Internat für schwer erziehbare Jungen. Dessen Direktor, ein unfähiger Pädagoge, traktiert seine Schüler nur mit Prügel und Arrest. Gegen den Widerstand des Direktors gründet Mathieu einen Chor und gewinnt allmählich das Vertrauen seiner widerspenstigen Schützlinge.

pr.d: In ihrer Blütezeit, im ersten Jahrtausend nach Christus, bauten die Maya die Stadt Chichén Itzá auf der mexikanischen Halbinsel Yucatán. Nur wenige 100 Jahre später ging ihre Kultur unter. Urwald überwucherte die verwaiste Stadt, bis sie Ende des 19. Jahrhunderts wiederentdeckt und freigelegt wurde. Seitdem suchen Archäologen nach dem Grund für den Untergang der Maya.
pr.sub: Chichen-Itza: Das Geheimnis vom Untergang der Maya (Mexiko)

pr.d: Es geht um das Wichtigste aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur, Sport und Wissenschaft. Korrespondenten der ARD sorgen für schnelle und präzise News. Die Tagesschau-Ausgaben zur vollen Stunde werden teilweise mit Videotext-Untertiteln ausgestrahlt.

Der Kommissar Hamza Kulina trifft seine Ex-Freundin Almila auf einer Mahnwache für Opfer eines Hochhausbrandes wieder. Almila bittet ihn um Hilfe, da ein Untersuchungsausschuss droht, ergebnislos zu enden. Sie vermutet billiges, nicht vorschriftsmäßiges Dämmmaterial als Brandursache. Hamza und seine Kollegin Maryam Azadi ermitteln und stoßen über einen Todesfall auf den Geschäftsführer eines Baustoffkonzerns mit politischen Kontakten. Die Suche nach der Wahrheit bringt die Kommissare in Gefahr.

Die Geologin Ina Sedlitz kehrt nach vielen Jahren in ihr Heimatdorf Neukirch zurück. Ina will nur eines: ihren Erbteil am Familienhotel an ihre Nichte Mara übertragen und endgültig mit der Vergangenheit abschließen. Doch als sie gebeten wird, ein geologisches Gutachten für den künstlich angelegten See zu erstellen, stößt sie auf gefährliche Instabilitäten und auf die Schatten eines wohl lange verdrängten Familiengeheimnisses. Ina steht vor einer Entscheidung, die alles verändert.

Der 19-jährige Talib stirbt auf dem Polizeirevier an seinen schweren Verletzungen. Daraufhin kommt es zu heftigen Protesten in einem dänischen Getto. Zwei ungleiche Polizisten werden auf Streife geschickt, um die heftigen Unruhen unter Kontrolle zu bringen. Als sie jedoch einen der Unruhestifter festnehmen, eskaliert die Situation. Die beiden Gesetzeshüter sind gezwungen, mit dem Gefangenen zu fliehen, doch der Vorort verwandelt sich immer mehr zu einem Bürgerkriegsschauplatz.

Dichte Wälder, weite Seenlandschaften und Häuser wie aus dem Märchenbuch: Schweden gehört zu den populärsten europäischen Reisezielen. Die Reise beginnt in Motala am Göta-Kanal. In dem verschlafenen Dörfchen trifft Reporterin Andrea Jansen auf Olaf Svensson. Der ehemalige Topmanager hat vor Jahren seinen Beruf aufgegeben, um sich seinen größten Wunsch zu erfüllen: Kapitän zu sein auf einem eigenen Schiff.

Phil and Gil host the week's third visit at Old Hall Country Breaks in Norfolk. The attention-to-detail at their self-catering accommodation gets the seal of approval from everyone, and Phil and Gil keep them sweet with a chocolatier experience.

The competition begins at Lodge Duxford in Cambridgeshire, where hosts Lucy and Craig hope their boutique hotel will tick all the boxes. A trip to see some vintage RAF planes sends group relations soaring.
Jo and Annabel welcome the B&Bers to their modern aparthotel Emerald Stays in Stratford-upon-Avon, where the guests ponder whether to use or not to use the self-catering facilities.

Karen and Adrian stake a claim for being the busiest B&Bers in 'Four in a Bed' history at The Barn in North Yorkshire. One guest reckons that such a big to-do list means the hosts haven't paid enough attention to his poached eggs at breakfast.

The week's final visit is to Dilham Hall Retreats in Norfolk, hosted by farming couple Louise and Luke. Their riverside pods take everyone's breath away, and a boat ride on the Norfolk Broads leaves them all feeling calm and serene.
It's been a week of tired eyes and undesired flies. Who will overcome their setbacks and emerge victorious on payment day?

pr.d: Der Stollen ist in Sachsen eine Art Nationalheiligtum. Die Dresdenerin Marianne Van Aertryck ist Ernährungsberaterin und bäckt zum ersten Mal einen veganen Stollen. Für den Dresdner Bäckermeister Frank Gehre ist ein Stollen ohne Butter kein Original.

Der Centraltirgus in Riga ist einer der größten Lebensmittelmärkte Europas. Der Markt, dessen Hallen sich an die für ihre Jugendstil-Architektur berühmte Altstadt anschließen, überrascht seine Besucher mit Spezialitäten aus den ausgedehnten Wäldern des Landes, seinen Birkenhainen, Flachlandgebieten und zahlreichen Flüssen. Die Art des Brotbackens, des Angelns und auch des Melkens der Birken im Frühjahr beruht auf alten Traditionen.

Während des Vormarsches von Hitlers Truppen nach Westen werden im Mai 1940 etwa 400.000 alliierte Soldaten in dem nordfranzösischen Küstenort Dünkirchen eingeschlossen. Ihre Lage, eingekesselt zwischen der Nordsee und dem Feind, scheint aussichtslos. Doch in Großbritannien ersinnt man einen tollkühnen Rettungsplan: Unterstützt von Bodentruppen und Piloten der RAF sollen die Eingeschlossenen mit zahllosen kleinen Schiffen und Booten übers Wasser evakuiert werden.

Die deutsche U-Boot-Flotte hatten noch lange nach dem Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs den Ruf, nahezu unbesiegbar gewesen zu sein. Tatsächlich sind Hitlers "Graue Wölfe" aber eher eine psychologische Waffe gewesen, ganz im Sinne der NS-Propaganda. Trotz der versenkten Tonnage der Alliierten konnten die deutschen U-Boote weder den feindlichen Nachschub wirksam unterbinden noch irgendein strategisches Ziel erreichen. Am Ende kostete die Wunderwaffe Hitlers vor allem Abertausende Menschen das Leben.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinettes Freundeskreis bekommt Zuwachs. Der Neuankömmling verwandelt sich jedoch in "Sole Crusher" - eine Superschurkin, die dazu in der Lage ist, Menschen zu absorbieren. Ladybug und Cat Noir stehen vor einer schwierigen Herausforderung.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Als Chloé zu Queen Banana akumatisiert wird, beschließt Ladybug, einer neuen und vielversprechenden Verbündeten ein Miraculous anzuvertrauen. Sie soll ihr dabei helfen, die Superschurkin und ihren Riesengorilla aufzuhalten.

Mulans alter, kranker Vater soll in die Armee eingezogen werden, um die einfallenden Mongolen zu bekämpfen. Da er in seinem Zustand die Strapazen des Krieges nicht überleben würde, verkleidet sich die junge Mulan als Mann und gibt sich als ihr Vater aus. Ihre Vorfahren sind mit diesem Plan nicht einverstanden und schicken deshalb den kleinen Drachen Mushu hinterher, um sie von ihrem Vorhaben abzubringen. Doch als er Mulan begegnet, schlägt er sich auf ihre Seite.

Tief unten in der Stille des Ozeans lebt Arielle, die Meerjungfrau. Sie ist die Tochter von Triton, dem Unterwasserkönig, aber anstatt ihren höfischen Pflichten nachzukommen, geht sie lieber zusammen mit dem kleinen Fisch Fabius auf Entdeckungsreise an die Oberfläche und sammelt Schätze von den Menschen. Arielle wünscht sich nämlich heimlich, selbst ein Mensch zu sein. Bei einem Unwetter rettet Arielle Prinz Eric das Leben und von da an ist es dann um sie geschehen.

Olaf erzählt die Geschichte von "Arielle, die Meerjungfrau" in seiner eigenen Interpretation. Dabei nimmt er die Figurenrollen von Arielle, Triton, Scuttle und auch dem Koch Louis ein sowie der bösen Meerhexe Ursula in bester Olaf-Manier.

pr.t: LEGO Disney Die Eiskönigin: Operation Papageientaucher
pr.d: No description available · EPGTalk.com
Bluey will, dass Dad ihr beim Zeichnen eines Drachens für ihre Geschichte hilft.
Coco möchte mit Indy Wilde Mädchen spielen, aber Chloe möchte, dass sie ein anderes Spiel spielt.
Die Väter kämpfen bei einem freundschaftlichen Kricketspiel in der Nachbarschaft um den Sieg.

Bluey und Bingo streiten sich diesmal um das magische Xylophon. Ihr Vater übernimmt indes die Kontrolle. Später wird Bluey mit der Unterstützung des Xylophons eingefroren. Bingo ist folglich die einzige Hoffnung, die bleibt.

Papa erhält diesmal eine wahrhaftig merkwürdige Röntgenaufnahme von Schwester Bingo. Doktor Bluey wird indes gerufen. Papa hat dem Anschein nach eine Katze in seinem Bauch. Er muss daher sofort von dem Doktor operiert werden.

Bluey und Bingo sind nicht gewillt, das Spielzimmer aufzuräumen, und finden eine Lösung. Sie beauftragen kurzerhand Papa Roboter, welcher die Arbeit prompt übernehmen soll. Letztlich geht der Roboter jedoch in die Brüche.
Bluey und seine Freunde spielen auf der Wiese. Sie dürfen nur die Schattenstellen berühren.

Bluey und Bingo spielen gemeinsam mit Papa im Garten. Plötzlich fällt Bingo ein wandelndes Blatt auf. Sie möchte es ihrem Papa zeigen. Doch dieser ist viel zu sehr mit dem Spiel beschäftigt und bemerkt sie deshalb nicht.

In dieser Folge möchte Bluey nicht ins Bett gehen und hat eine andere Idee. Sie wäre nämlich viel lieber ein nachtaktiver Flughund, damit sie die ganze Nacht wach bleiben kann. So fliegt sie schon bald durch den Nachthimmel.

Als Bluey vergisst, ihr Lieblingsspielzeug aufzuräumen, nimmt es sich ihre Cousine und gibt es nicht wieder her. Die anderen Kinder versuchen, sie abzulenken und inszenieren eine Pferdehochzeit mit Papa und ihrem Onkel als Pferde.

Dad lässt sich in dieser Episode in ein Hotel-Spiel verwickeln. Bluey und Bingo leiten das Hotel. Dad nimmt die Rolle des umsorgten Gastes ein. Bluey neigt dazu, das Spiel an sich zu reißen. Aus diesem Grund will Bingo nicht mehr spielen.

Bluey versucht Fahrrad fahren zu lernen, doch das ist schwieriger als gedacht. Als sie jedoch ihre Freunde dabei beobachten, wie sie versuchen ihre Aufgaben zu meistern und nicht aufgeben, hat sie die Motivation es noch einmal zu versuchen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinette schleicht sich in ein Haus, als dort ein privates Dinner abgehalten wird.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Als Malediktator zurückkehrt und nun von einem Sentimonster unterstützt wird, vertraut Ladybug einem engagierten Freund und Verbündeten ein Miraculous an, um Paris zu retten.

Als Taro in der Schule geärgert wird, greift Yuna ein. Er fordert Kennys Dojo zu einem Duell der Karate-Schulen heraus. Stitch verliert ein wertvolles Erinnerungsstück von Yuna und findet es überraschend beim Kampf der Dojos wieder.

Nach einer Bruchlandung findet sich Stitch in Japan wieder. Er lernt Yuna kennen, die ihn bei sich und ihrer Familie aufnimmt. Sie werden Freunde und Stitch lernt Japan kennen und erfährt die Legende vom magischen Stein. Dieser kann Wünsche erfüllen. Auch Stitch hat einen Wunsch, aber damit der Wunsch in Erfüllung gehen kann, muss Stitch zuerst 43 gute Taten erfüllen. Eine fast unmögliche Aufgabe für den Rabauken Stitch.
pr.sub: Stitch gegen Dr. van Hamsterdam Teil 1

pr.d: Yuna muss Dr. van Hamsterdam und seinen teuflischen Plan stoppen. Ansonsten kann Dr. van Hamsterdam sein Ziel erreichen und wird Herrscher des gesamten Universums.
Cricket ist krank und kann seine Pflichten nicht erfüllen. Daher springt seine Familie für ihn ein.

Bill hat eine riesige Wassermelone gezogen. Cricket lädt daraufhin gleich den lokalen Fernsehsender ein, um von der Sensation Megamelone zu berichten. Cricket wehrt sich gegen die gemeinen Mobbingattacken der Cyber Knights.

Mama denkt, dass Bluey noch zu jung für Schach ist, als Papa versucht, ihr das Spiel beibringen zu wollen. Es dauert nicht lang, bis Bingo sich anschließt, woraufhin die Kinder ihre eigenen Regeln erfinden, doch kann Papa nicht immer verlieren.

Mama gönnt sich ihre wohlverdiente Pause und Papa spielt daher mit Bluey und Bingo Schafshund. Dies soll die Kinder davon abhalten, Mama bei ihrer Pause zu stören. Die Aufgabe entpuppt sich jedoch als schwieriger, als sie erwartet haben.
Die Eltern wollen ihre Hausarbeit erst beenden, wenn die Kinder aufhören, sich albern zu benehmen.

Luckys Vater ist empört darüber, dass das moderne Päckchenspiel ein Geschenk in jeder Lage hat. Er ändert deshalb die Regeln wieder, sodass es wie ursprünglich nur einen Preis in der Mitte gibt. Aber Bingo verliert immer.

Blueys Vatertagskarte soll perfekt werden, aber sie kann sich nicht entscheiden, was sie malen soll. Mama erinnert sie an all die spaßigen Momente, die sie mit ihrem Vater hatte und daran, dass er auch nicht perfekt ist.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Als seine Plattenfirma den Rocker Jagged Stone zu einem Duett mit dem Popstar Mr. XY zwingen will, nutzt Hawk Moth die Wut des Rockers und verwandelt ihn in Guitar Villain. Unterdessen überredet Bob Marinette dazu, Stones Albumcover zu gestalten.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinettes Onkel, der weltberühmte Koch Cheng Sifu, besucht Paris, um an einem Kochwettbewerb teilzunehmen. Als Chloé seine Vorspeise ruiniert, nutzt Hawk Moth seine Wut, um ihn in Kung Food zu verwandeln. Der Bösewicht hat es auf Chloé abgesehen.

Mogli freut sich, dass er im Menschendorf leben darf und dort eine Familie und Freunde gefunden hat. Er sehnt sich aber auch nach seinen Freunden im Dschungel. Auch Balu vermisst seinen kleinen Freund und entschließt sich dazu, Mogli wieder in den Dschungel zurückzuholen. Die beiden beschließen, noch einmal eine tolle Zeit bei ihren alten Freunden zu verbringen. Jedoch hat Shanti die Freunde beobachtet und folgt ihnen.
Percy, Annabeth und Grover werden von einem furchterregenden Gegner um einen Gefallen gebeten.
pr.sub: Ein Gott lädt uns zu Cheeseburgern ein

pr.d: Percy, Annabeth und Grover gelangen auf der Suche nach Antworten in ein Casino in Las Vegas.

pr.d: Jills Eltern wollen zu Besuch kommen, aber sie will nach den Prüfungen lieber ihre Ruhe haben. Sie gibt vor, krank zu sein und sagt den Eltern ab. Wenig später erreicht sie ein Brief, dass ihr Vater plötzlich verstorben ist.
Randy bittet seine Angebetete Laureen endlich um ein Rendezvous. Doch im Restaurant wird er wegen seines Alters nicht ganz ernst genommen. Doch dann taucht Wilson auf und hilft ihm.

Der jährliche Familienausflug zur Haushaltswarenausstellung in Cleveland steht bevor. Jill freut sich, mit den Kindern etwas unternehmen zu können und Tim moderiert von dort aus seine Sendung. Die Kinder haben jedoch dort andere Pläne.

Levelling-up leaders and environmental activists clash in a small town trying to look to the future. With a sabotaged train and a dead mayor, the activists become suspects.

The chance discovery of a camera and rolls of film hidden in a pub toilet leads the team to reopen the case of a young man murdered whilst working in a photography shop. The films contain some suspicious photographs, and it seems possible that the motive for murder was linked to this, but it becomes apparent that the solution has more to do with the DNA found on the camera.

Gordon travels to Philadelphia to visit a Mexican restaurant called Zocalo. At one point, this restaurant played Cupid to a young couple who met, fell in love and married while working here together. Greg and Mary Russell loved the place so much that they pooled their resources and bought it. However, it seems that Cupid's arrow had a poisoned tip: the restaurant has become an albatross around their necks.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, to try to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. Saki Kavouniaris took over the failing Spin-a-Yarn restaurant in 1995 and began to turn it into a success. He fell in love with a waitress, but the restaurant and the marriage are now failing.

Gordon heads to Boston for the first of two visits to La Galleria 33, an Italian restaurant opened in 2006 by raucous sisters Rita and Lisa. The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. The sisters blame everything from the weather to the tablecloths for their failures.

Gordon confronts restaurant owners and sisters Rita and Lisa with an ultimatum. His stand-off with the siblings is just the beginning of the explosive action. He finds himself stuck in a war between the waiters, chefs and owners over who is to blame for the restaurant's failings. Can Gordon wrangle these hapless proprietors and stubborn employees back into one productive team and save the restaurant?

It's the semi-final and time for the bakers to showcase their patisserie prowess. Their precision, patience and pastry skills are pushed to the limit as they strive to prove they have what it takes to make it through to the final.

When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart protests by hooking himself up with Tom, a surrogate dad from an agency. Stung by being jilted by his own son, Homer gets into a monster brawl with Tom that even makes the news.

Valentine's Day comes to Springfield and Lisa takes pity on Ralph and gives him a card, but when Ralph falls in love with Lisa their friendship turns bad, causing a bitter feud to break out between the two families.

After Homer fails a breathalyser test-driving home from a visit to the Duff brewery, he is forced to quit drinking for a month. Meanwhile, Lisa buys a hamster for her school science project, in order to prove that Bart is dumber than a rodent.

Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control. When Homer leads the workers out on strike, Mr Burns retaliates by hiring robots to replace them and shutting off power to the city.

When a huge snowdrift engulfs the school, the kids rebel, gagging Principal Skinner, tying him to a chair and running amok. Meanwhile, Homer and Flanders' rescue operation is going disastrously, and the fate of Skinner and the kids rests in the paws of a lone hamster.

Detective Scott Turner is an uptight, by-the-book police officer who hopes to leave his sleepy California town and work in the big city. When his friend Amos Reed, the proprietor of a junkyard, is killed, Turner reluctantly inherits the man's dog. Realising that the canine may be able to help him solve the murder case, Turner attempts to adjust to life with the big dog, resulting in much household destruction and unwelcome chaos.

Für ein attraktives Jobangebot will ein junges Paar nach Belgien ziehen. Der alte Hund soll mit umziehen. Die neue Umgebung lockt, und sie freuen sich auf ein neues Zuhause. Dass der Hund sich dort auch wohlfühlt, ist den beiden sehr wichtig.

Der ruhige Küstenort Rocky Point liegt auf Long Island. Dort wechseln sich Wald und Strand harmonisch ab, was die Preise der Immobilien in die Höhe treibt. Doch Sara und Justin sind auf der Jagd nach einem Strandhaus für höchstens 450.000 Dollar. Die beiden haben zwei Kinder und wollen ihre Wochenenden als Familie in der Natur verbringen. Das Traumhaus der Familie hat vier Schlafzimmer, zwei Bäder, eine große Küche und einen Garten.

Eine Patchworkfamilie ist auf der Suche nach einem Strandgrundstück in Hampton, Virginia, wo sie ihren Kindern eine schöne Ferienzeit am Meer ermöglichen können. Die Familie sucht ein Objekt mit mindestens zwei Schlafzimmern für Familie und Freunde.
Daphne und Ian möchten mehr Hochzeiten auf ihr Schloss holen und verwandeln dafür die in die Jahre gekommenen Toiletten in luxuriöse Gästeräume.

Daphne und Ian arbeiten mit Hochdruck daran, das Torhaus ihres Schlosses endlich fertigzustellen. Neben einer Galerie mit Blick auf das Schloss entstehen ein auffälliger Kronleuchter und ein maßgefertigter Katzenbaum für Kater Charlie.

Die Kalamas übernehmen ein renovierungsbedürftiges Haus in Manoa und glauben zunächst an einen vielversprechenden Fund. Doch beim Abriss kommen massive Probleme mit den Leitungen, Termitenschäden und eine kostspielige Überraschung zum Vorschein.

Kamohai und Tristyn besichtigen auf O'ahu ein stark verfallenes und vermülltes Haus, das seit 20 Jahren leer steht. Kamohai sieht das Potenzial, es nach der Renovierung für stolze 1,4 Millionen Dollar zu verkaufen und beginnt den Umbau.
Ein verheiratetes Surferpaar sucht in Virginia Beach nach einem bezahlbaren Strandhaus, das zu seinem Lebensstil passt.

Nach der Geburt ihres Kindes möchte ein Paar den eisigen Wintern in Michigan entkommen und sich in Fort Myers Beach in Florida niederlassen. Gesucht wird ein bezahlbares Strandhaus für das neue Familienleben unter Palmen.

Ein junges Paar wünscht sich ein neues Traumhaus mit tollem Ausblick auf Maui. Ihm ist dabei besonders wichtig, dass es einen Garten gibt, der sich zum Obst- und Gemüseanbau eignet. Das Budget liegt bei etwa 1,2 Millionen Dollar.

Susie und Marty träumen bereits seit ihren Flitterwochen davon, aus Seattle wegzuziehen und sich ein neues Leben auf Hawaii aufzubauen. Ihr neues Zuhause soll unbedingt Meerblick, Gästezimmer und einen Pool haben. Das Paar will viel surfen.

Laura kehrt nach 40 Jahren auf dem Festland zurück in ihre Heimat auf Maui. Gemeinsam mit ihrer Schwester sucht sie das perfekte Haus in Strandnähe mit altem Hawaii-Charme. Ihr großzügiges Budget bietet viele Möglichkeiten.

Mike und Masha tauchen für ihr Leben gern. Nun kehren sie nach 25 Jahren nach Hawaii zurück, um sich dort für immer niederzulassen. Auf "Big Island" sucht das sportbegeisterte Paar nach einem Haus am Wasser und mit Garten.

Lucy talks to a pastor and his wife who plan to build their dream eco house in Brompton in Kent. Meanwhile, Martin meets a first-time developer in Wolverhampton, and Dion looks at a huge building which already comes with a tenanted flat and a hair salon in Newcastle-under-Lyme.

A commercial and residential building in Beeston in Nottinghamshire, a four-storey house in East Dulwich in London and a flat in Godalming in Surrey are all given high-end makeovers. Will the developers, who all bought at auction, make a profit?

A 1930s semi in Hatfield in Hertfordshire, a flat in Croydon and a workshop and land in Heanor in Derbyshire are sold at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the owners and hear their plans to make money from their bricks and mortar.

A mum and dad buy a piece of land in Stevenage in Hertfordshire in the hope of developing a pair of houses for their children, a couple who buy a top-floor flat in Motherwell in Scotland want to make a profit on the rent, and two young brothers buy a run-down house in South Normanton.

A bungalow in Langton Green in Kent is given a high-end refurbishment and extension, a father-and-son team cleverly refigure the existing space in a terraced house in Stoke-on-Trent, and two lifelong friends have high hopes for a piece of land they buy behind a house they already own in Northwood in Middlesex.

A 1930s semi in Leamington Spa in Warwickshire, a terraced house in London's Plumstead and a workshop on the Isle of Sheppey in Kent are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin hear about the plans for the three properties.

Martin Roberts catches up on ambitious plans to redevelop the site of a former school in Ebbw Vale in Wales, while Dion Dublin talks to a first-time developer planning to extend up and out at a semi in Bloxwich in the West Midlands.
A flat in Sutton in London, a studio apartment in Chatham in Kent and a terraced house in Middlesbrough are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

A bungalow in Biggin Hill with huge potential, a centuries-old cottage in a beautiful part of Devon and an end terrace crying out for an upstairs bathroom are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear their plans.

Martel Maxwell joins the team, and looks at an old mews house in an historic part of Litchfield in Staffordshire, while Martin Roberts assesses the potential of a bungalow in Hanley in Stoke-on-Trent.

Martel Maxwell looks at a large terraced house in Dover in Kent with bags of potential, Martin Roberts is in Camborne in Cornwall viewing a house with lots of issues, and Dion Dublin meets a couple who bought a flat in Woodford Green in Essex.

Martel Maxwell is in Gillingham in Kent meeting a couple embarking on their first renovation development, Martin Roberts talks to a man with ambitious plans for a house in London's Chingford, and Dion Dublin looks round a semi in Wolverhampton.

Martel Maxwell hears development plans for a two-bedroom flat in Godalming in Surrey, Martin Roberts looks at a house in a terrible state of repair in Telford in Shropshire, and Dion Dublin sizes up the work needing to be done at a terraced house in Smethwick in the West Midlands.
A flat with great sea views in Margate in Kent, a bungalow in Whaley Thorns in Nottinghamshire and an end terrace in Longbridge in Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.
A listed building in Brentwood in Essex dating back to the 16th-century is sold under the hammer, along with a flat in Halesowen in Birmingham and an end terrace in Northwood in Stoke-on-Trent.

A large semi in New Barnet in London is bought as an ambitious project to turn into a family home, a family do up a semi in Dover in Kent to make a profit, and two friends club together to try their hand at refurbishing a terraced house in Derby.

Emilia examines three murders which shook Beenham in the 1960s. One of the murders went unsolved for 40 years, until detectives vowed to finally seek justice.
This series looks at some of Britain's darkest murder locations. With Anita Rani at the helm this series promises to shine new light on some of the most fascinating cases from all.
Katherine Kelly examines the 1986 murder of 16-year-old Elaine Doyle. One of Scotland's longest-running murder enquiries, it took 26 years to find her killer.

When a holistic doctor with a burgeoning TV career is bludgeoned to death inside her home, it's a random tip that leads to justice being served.

On New Year's Day in 2014, a father in a small Pennsylvania town reports his 23-year-old daughter, Ashley Kline, missing. A few weeks later, hikers stumble upon her charred remains. It's clear Ashley was brutally assaulted and then set on fire.

A gunman kills volunteer police officer, Laura Grillo, in her suburban Dallas home. At first, detectives suspect a burglar fleeing the scene. But investigators link a bombshell accusation to a diabolical mastermind who thinks he can outsmart the law.
Royal Canadian Mounted Police discover the body of 81-year-old recluse Elsie Steppa inside her hoarder home with a bloody ice-axe beside her. Now, it's up to the Mounties to track down the killer.
On Easter Sunday, the remains of a woman are found. Years later, a determined attorney and new DNA technology bring the case to its shocking conclusion.
After detectives find a popular hairstylist stabbed to death, their suspects include the victim's landlord, her married lover, and an aggressive ex-boyfriend.

In Connecticut, a highway maintenance crew find a suitcase containing human remains. As the list of potential suspects grows, solving the case may hinge on a portrait of the killer sketched by the victim's own hand.

James' culinary tour of Britain continues in Scotland with a trip to Blair Castle in the Highlands. He is joined by top Scottish Michelin starred chef Tom Kitchin. James kicks off the cooking with his venison with beetroot and blackberries in the castle's walled garden. Next Tom Kitchin dusts off his wellies and heads into the woods for a bit of wild mushroom foraging.

Burnley take on Blackburn Rovers in the East Lancashire Derby, and there is famous and old rivalry between the two clubs. Just 11 miles separates the two towns, and the first time they played each was in 1884, and they have met many times since. pr.t: Outlier: Manager Idol: Luton Town - The Football Revolution [NEW]
pr.d: This premium sports documentary tells the stranger-than-fiction story of the only manager in British football to ever be appointed by a phone vote. The story of a chairman inspired by Pop Idol in a bid to win over fans, during a summer where the money men and fans went to battle for control of Luton Town football club. In 2003, Luton Town were in crisis. New chairman John Gurney was the face of a mystery consortium that turned fans against their own club. Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too.
Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when everyone finds out that Mr Bull and Mrs Cow are going to get married the next day.
Everyone is getting ready for Mr Bull and Mrs Cow's wedding, going to the jewellers to get rings, to the dress makers... and to sort out the wedding cake.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
The children are at the Elf Farm, but to learn where milk comes from they must visit a big farm, to find cows. They travel to Lucy Big's farm, where she shows them all the animals.
Mummy and Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have a wonderful day with Mr. Potato at Digger World.
When Peppa gets Teddy dirty jumping in muddy puddles, she goes to The Doll Hospital.
George has a new hat and Mummy Pig is determined that George doesn't get it muddy when visiting Grandpa and Granny Pig.
It's Captain Daddy Dog's birthday and Mummy Dog surprises him with the gift of a boat trip, which isn't quite what he had expected.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers. The children enjoy identifying Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even an orchid.
Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party, and Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick and tries to show how to use it, but finds it difficult. Peppa and her friends struggle too. But there's always jumping in muddy puddles.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere! So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day.
On a windy day, the team has to band together for an important delivery. When it seems the elements will be too much, they learn they can ask each other for help.
Paddington builds a robot in 'Paddington Meets PaddingTron', then in 'Paddington's First Diwali', Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him and Paddington is his helpful assistant.
Paddington has a race against time in 'Paddington and the Solar Eclipse', then in 'Paddington and the Mysterious Inventor', Simi receives an inventor's award, but why does she feel sad.
The Browns go to the beach in 'Paddington's Summer Holiday Begins', then in 'Paddington's Life Guard Training', Paddington, Jonathan and Judy rescue Mr Brown with lifeguard Taylor's help.
Something is making strange noises in 'Paddington's Mysterious Cave Discovery', and in 'Paddington and the Fossil Hunt', Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but isn't having any luck.
Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School, and learn about what to expect when the baby arrives.
Peppa is given the very important task of suggesting names for the new baby. She thinks of all sorts of names, but they aren't quite right.

The nurse visits, and she decides that today's visit should be all about how to hold a baby. The nurse shows Peppa a special way for a small person to safely hold a baby.
Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss and suggests George tries a hearing aid.

Carlos and Tracker make PawPaw juice with the Paw Patrol when they find out Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta are in trouble.

pr.sub: Paddington's Race Against the Storm; Paddington's Super Snail

pr.d: Paddington and Robot Paddington enjoy being heroes, Paddington discovers how to be calm.
pr.sub: Paddington and Paddingtron's Heroic Day / Paddington's Heroic Non-Stop Adventure

pr.d: Paddington tries to figure out who stole Mr. Curry's prized Giant Pumpkin, Mr. Gruber teaches Paddington how to skate for the ice disco.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Vegetable Thief; Paddington Takes to the Ice

pr.d: Tim searches the kitchen, reads labels and ingredients to find a hogweed-free snack for Kai.
Tim tries to bend all the rules when Terri comes to babysit.
Tim tries to get rid of a troublesome spider from his house.
A gang of squirrels appear at the Great Elf Tree. They are determined to store their acorns inside, but the Wise Old Elf has a cunning plan to stop them.
Out playing in the meadow, Holly, Ben and their friends find a broken toy robot. Holly fixes it with magic, but the robot does not behave as they thought it would.
Stan, Grace and Brody form a band, but a mystery drummer joins in somewhere across town. Stan and Gran go on a hunt for their invisible bandmate!
Strange holes in garden fences are popping up all over Porthole and Stink has gone missing! Stan and Gran spy a mystery and decide to investigate.
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
pr.sub: Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter

pr.d: Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip. The Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
pr.sub: Pups Stop the Garboni; Pups Save the Porcupine

pr.d: Bobbi befriends some space rock aliens. They love playing with Bobbi and refuse to let him go. Professor Scratch invents a tracker to locate all of Sir Steel's missing socks which come to life!
pr.sub: Rocks To The Rescue / Sock Shock

pr.d: Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they [LIVE], play and build whatever the community needs.
pr.sub: The Crew Fixes A Blocked Pipe/The Crew Builds A Construction Basketball Show

pr.d: There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it!
Sir Steel sails towards a purple slime waterfall unaware, as he's too busy meditating. Drillnose Beetles are destroying the forest and so two mystery heroes have to reveal themselves.
pr.sub: Steel Man Steel; The Mystery Heroes

pr.d: Kai is super excited to ride the Nebulator, but Tim is not so sure.
Tim and Dad have to catch a troublesome mole.
Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.
The Gabby Cats need to make a special art project for Baby Box's Meow-Seum Day; with many different ways to make art, who knows what they'll create.
When Gabby and Pandy turn tiny from one of MerCat's potions, they'll need to gather the right ingredients to help them grow back to their usual size.
Begonia, Lily, and Blossom teach Wild a lesson after he steals their cupcakes; Chef is worried when the main ingredient for his famous Equinox pie, the Yummyus, is late blooming.
pr.sub: Wild Gets Tamed; The Yummyus Pie

pr.d: The Crew makes the biggest pancake ever in 'The Crew Builds A Pancake Café', then in 'The Crew Builds An Aeroplane Wash', the pups wash Camila's plane.
pr.sub: The Crew Builds A Pancake Cafe / The Crew Builds An Airplane Wash

pr.d: When the Hidden Jungle animals appear to be uncharacteristically frightened, Marshall discovers a sabre-toothed tiger has been stalking them. The big-fanged tiger is not the only creature strangely awakening from long, long ago.
pr.sub: Jungle Pups: Pups Save the Big, Big Animals

pr.d: Humdinger and Boomer join forces to get Roxy out of the way so that the two can put on the ultimate monster truck show and Humdinger can show off for his mum.
pr.sub: Rescue Wheels: Pups vs. The Monster Mayor

pr.d: Adventure Bay gets a brand-new airport, and Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
Poor Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, but this changes when King Thistle finds out.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
The children are playing a game of superheroes. When Strawberry takes her super villain role a bit too far, it is up to the 'Elf Man' and 'Fairy Girl' to save the day.
When Redbeard, who is giving Nanny Plum, Ben and Holly a ride on his 'unsinkable' boat, hits a rock, he calls on the services of Elf Rescue.
When Francois accidentally crashes his diving bell, the PAW Patrol must rescue him; when Wingnut's junk pile and Oscar go missing at the same time, Chase and team are called in to solve the mystery.
pr.sub: Pups Save the Whale Pod; Ultimate Rescue: Pups Stop the Junk-Monster

pr.d: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares some tales that speak to the soul.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
King Thistle is bored in the Royal Castle and takes up the hobby of birdwatching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
When Percy and Kana have a near-collision, they enlist Safety Engine Emily and go to ridiculous extremes to introduce safety measures all over Sodor.
When Bulstrode and Cranky get into their crankiest fight yet, they learn how to express their feelings in order to save their friendship.
Dora and Boots help Benny perfect a new move in time for the championship volleyball game. Dora and Boots show Dulce the dragon that everyone's differences are what make them excellent!
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Tim and Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Lake Monster; Paddington's Space Radio

pr.d: Humdinger and Boomer join forces to get Roxy out of the way so that the two can put on the ultimate monster truck show and Humdinger can show off for his mum.
pr.sub: Rescue Wheels: Pups vs. The Monster Mayor

pr.d: Adventure Bay gets a brand-new airport, and Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
Poor Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, but this changes when King Thistle finds out.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
The children are playing a game of superheroes. When Strawberry takes her super villain role a bit too far, it is up to the 'Elf Man' and 'Fairy Girl' to save the day.
When Redbeard, who is giving Nanny Plum, Ben and Holly a ride on his 'unsinkable' boat, hits a rock, he calls on the services of Elf Rescue.
When Francois accidentally crashes his diving bell, the PAW Patrol must rescue him; when Wingnut's junk pile and Oscar go missing at the same time, Chase and team are called in to solve the mystery.
pr.sub: Pups Save the Whale Pod; Ultimate Rescue: Pups Stop the Junk-Monster

pr.d: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares some tales that speak to the soul.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
King Thistle is bored in the Royal Castle and takes up the hobby of birdwatching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
When Percy and Kana have a near-collision, they enlist Safety Engine Emily and go to ridiculous extremes to introduce safety measures all over Sodor.
When Bulstrode and Cranky get into their crankiest fight yet, they learn how to express their feelings in order to save their friendship.
Dora and Boots help Benny perfect a new move in time for the championship volleyball game. Dora and Boots show Dulce the dragon that everyone's differences are what make them excellent!
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Tim and Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Lake Monster; Paddington's Space Radio

pr.d: The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no one can eat her cakes.
Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill; Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.
It is back to Granny Pig's historical re-enactment society for a space adventure, as Peppa and George re-enact the Apollo moon landing.
Grandpa can't find his old metal detector to look for the key for George's new toy robot lost in the long grass.
During playgroup, Madame Gazelle takes everyone outside to play Parachute Games.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy.
Mummy and Daddy Pig are working in their home office and Peppa wants to 'work' like them too. Peppa decides that she needs her own office, so she takes the cupboard under the stairs.
During another visit to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house, Grandpa takes everyone to show them the new Bug Hotel he is building.
Madame Gazelle introduces the playgroup to the wonderful world of poetry - and the wonderful world of wooly socks.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new club house and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's House to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa learns babies are not like dolls at all, and do lots of things every day.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick and tries to show how to use it, but finds it difficult. Peppa and her friends struggle too. But there's always jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George have been sailing with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Back at the clubhouse, they discover a jukebox - but it is very noisy.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa and her family are visiting an adventure park. Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they have fun working their way around an obstacle course.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the apartment. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss and suggests George tries a hearing aid.
While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.
Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and more.
Peppa and her friends visit visit the cinema for the first time to watch the Super Potato movie.
Peppa and George have come to play at Granny and Grandpa's house. Everyone dresses as dinosaurs having lots of fun and a bit of a party.
Peppa helps Danny Dog with a bedroom makeover on the theme of pirates and sea monsters in Danny's Pirate Bedroom.
Grandpa Pig found his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to leave! Peppa and Suzy look after him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable.
Daddy Pig requires help in finding his car in the car park.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig teaches Peppa how to wink. Zoe has come to visit with her toy monkey, so Peppa teaches her what she's learnt.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog take Peppa, George and Danny bowling. Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig have never been before.
Madame Gazelle has organised a roller disco for the children.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers. The children enjoy identifying Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even an orchid.
Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Madame Gazelle is teaching the children fun games to play with paper.
Peppa and George join Granny Pig and her friends to play at being Vikings.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
It's a lovely day to visit the beach - or it would be, if it wasn't snowing. Miss Rabbit's snow plough saves the day. Mummy Pig goes for a swim, but finds it colder than expected.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza & Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Daddy Pig loves to watch TV, but Peppa thinks that Daddy is not very fit and needs to do some exercise. Daddy Pig disagrees, but says that Peppa can help.
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig, and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre and she puts on a very funny puppet show with Peppa and George.
Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep comes to play with Peppa. The little boys don't want to play the same games as Peppa and Suzy.
When it comes to pancake making, Daddy Pig thinks he is a bit of an expert. But he has a tendency to flip the pancakes a bit too high..
George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand new clothes.
Peppa discovers that even "boring, dry leaves" can be fun when you jump up and down in them.
Peppa and George go ice skating for the first time. Peppa finds it is quite difficult not to fall over.
Peppa and her family have been on a trip to a mountain beauty spot. When Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a drain, Mr Bull offers to find them with his digger.
Mr Bull in a China Shop: Accidentally breaking his delicate teapot, Mr Bull takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and her family go camping. They put up their tent, collect sticks for a campfire and listen to the beautiful sounds of the great outdoors.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club - going on secret missions, and doing secret things. In secret. But soon everyone wants to join.
Doctor Hamster is having a busy day - there are lots of helpless animals that need her help.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.
To celebrate Freddy Fox's birthday, the children go on a trip to a Dinosaur Park. With Grampy Rabbit as their leader, they follow dinosaur footprints to find Freddy's birthday treat.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.

Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals, but when all the families have a race, he soon wishes he had picked something easier to sail.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.

It's time for playgroup, and Peppa and friends are thinking about what they want to be when they grow up. Some in the group want to be nurses, police officers and even pirates, but Peppa takes a little while to figure out what she wants to be.
Grandpa Pig pops round with some seeds for Peppa and George to plant, with Daddy Pig helping out by acting as a scarecrow.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play, and Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood.
When Mummy Pig helps out at Miss Rabbit's fire station, she is called upon to douse the flames at Daddy Pig's out-of-control barbecue.
Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George, an invitation to her birthday party.
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park where there is lots of fun to be had with vegetables.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Tiddles gets stuck in a tree and needs to be rescued. When the turtle falls on Pedro's nose, he needs to go to the doctors to make sure everything is OK.
Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again, Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep some old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young, but they are pleased to see that they have always been best friends.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van, even a chicken.
Peppa and George want to be famous detectives like their favourite television programme 'Detective Potato', so Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
